coding.note: C1 is restricted to abstract/introduction contributions; QK-Reorder-LN and AGAPO are described only later and are not added as C1 claims. No controlled hybrid-attention ablation is reported. Response resampling is not independent training replication. Data categories are disclosed, but no reconstructable pretraining mixture. External leaderboard scores concern baselines, not an independently evaluated EXAONE 4.0 release, so third_party is conservatively NO. AGAPO combines modifications to prior methods rather than explicitly renaming an unchanged existing technique.
